title: Oven Roasted Japanese Citrus Kaiseki Course
description: A comforting and citrusy Japanese dish featuring canola oil and a mother-sauce-base, low in carbs and perfect for a special occasion.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a small bowl, whisk together yuzu juice, sudachi juice, and mirin to make the mother-sauce-base.
Brush the salmon fillets with canola oil and season with salt and pepper.
Place the salmon fillets on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper and roast in the oven for 12 minutes.
While the salmon is cooking, combine dashi broth and kombu in a saucepan and bring to a boil over high heat.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer the broth for 5 minutes, then strain and discard the kombu.
Add the sliced shimeji mushrooms to the broth and simmer for an additional 2 minutes.
To serve, place a roasted salmon fillet on each plate, then spoon the mushroom and broth mixture over the top.
Garnish with thinly sliced scallions and toasted sesame seeds.
Drizzle the mother-sauce-base over the dish and serve immediately.
